description: HP-31 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) based in Sundernagar, serving the Mandi district of Himachal Pradesh. It operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and is responsible for vehicle registrations, issuing driving licenses, and managing transport permits for the region. This office is a vital transport node for the major commercial and educational hub of Sundernagar.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Sundernagar, District Mandi, Himachal Pradesh
